page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.large is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance provides 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

The instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this configuration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from other tenants.

Due to its high memory density relative to processing cores, the ecs.r8i.large is designed for workloads requiring significant RAM but moderate CPU resources. This hardware profile is suitable for small-scale database hosting, caching layers, in-memory data processing, and enterprise applications with memory-heavy footprints. The dedicated resource model offers predictable performance, making it a cost-efficient choice for memory-bound tasks that do not require high-frequency parallel computing or local NVMe storage.
